width.extreme_pass: >=4/5 judges correct on b3w6 (3v9, delta=6) — validates substrate; failing this invalidates the session
width.jnd_bracket: lowest delta=2 pair with >=4/5 agreement gives the JND floor; if b3w2 (5v7) fails while b3w1 (3v5) and b3w3 (7v9) pass, nonlinearity confirmed — JND is position-dependent
width.nonlinearity_test: b3w2 agreement < b3w1 agreement AND b3w2 agreement < b3w3 agreement -> perceptual nonlinearity confirmed; if all delta=2 pairs pass, JND is uniformly below 2 and linearity holds
width.bridge_pass: >=4/5 correct on b3w4 and b3w5 (delta=4) -> JND is below 4 across the range; if any delta=4 pair fails, regenerate at delta=6 next batch
width.verdict_rule: extreme_pass + nonlinearity_test -> line_weight validated with position-dependent JND; extreme_pass + linearity -> line_weight validated with uniform JND; extreme_fail -> substrate failure, regenerate stimuli

taper_direction.magnitude_control: >=4/5 correct on b3t5 -> judges can discriminate taper magnitude; failing this invalidates taper direction results
taper_direction.direction_pass: >=4/5 judges select toward-tip side on b3t1 and b3t2 -> taper direction affects perceived hand-drawnness
taper_direction.conflict_resolution: b3t3 (toward-low vs away-mid): if >=4/5 select toward, direction dominates; if >=4/5 select away, magnitude dominates; 2/3 split -> both cues matter, interaction confirmed
taper_direction.extreme_conflict: b3t6 (toward-low vs away-high): if judges select away, magnitude fully dominates direction; if toward, direction is robust even under extreme magnitude conflict
taper_direction.verdict_rule: direction_pass + magnitude_control -> taper direction promoted to hand-drawnness axis; direction_pass + magnitude_dominates on b3t3/b3t6 -> direction is secondary cue, magnitude primary; direction_fail -> taper direction does not affect hand-drawnness, taper is magnitude-only

pass_criteria.general: any scored pair with a 50/50 judge split is a stimulus failure, not human noise: regenerate at higher parameter delta in the next batch

adaptive_rules.catch_fail: a judge answering >1 catch pair with a side choice instead of 'no difference' is excluded from aggregates; recruit a replacement to hold n=5
adaptive_rules.width_fail: if 5v7 fails but 3v5 and 7v9 pass: nonlinearity confirmed, next batch probes 4v6 and 6v8 to map the nonlinear region; if all delta=2 pass: next batch probes delta=1 (3v4, 5v6, 7v8) to tighten the JND
adaptive_rules.taper_direction_fail: if b3t1 and b3t2 fail (judges don't distinguish direction): taper direction does not affect hand-drawnness, drop from registry; if b3t1 passes but b3t2 fails: direction effect is magnitude-dependent, next batch probes at taper=0.15 toward vs away
adaptive_rules.taper_magnitude_dominates: if b3t3 and b3t6 both select away side: magnitude fully dominates, direction is noise on hand-drawnness; if b3t3 selects toward but b3t6 selects away: direction dominates at small magnitude gaps, magnitude at large gaps
adaptive_rules.stimulus_fail: 50/50 splits get regenerated at higher contrast next batch and logged as stimulus-quality data
adaptive_rules.convergence: two consecutive batches with agreement values inside each other's bootstrap CIs at target n ends the loop for that dimension; the plateau is the metric's honest ceiling

registry_consequences.width_nonlinear_pass: line_weight -> validated with position-dependent JND, nonlinearity recorded as perceptual property
registry_consequences.width_linear_pass: line_weight -> validated with uniform JND at delta<=2
registry_consequences.width_fail: line_weight -> stays measurable, JND work queued with finer steps
registry_consequences.taper_direction_pass: taper -> promoted with direction component on hand-drawnness axis, controllable_track
registry_consequences.taper_direction_magnitude_dominates: taper -> direction is secondary cue, magnitude primary; direction recorded as modifier
registry_consequences.taper_direction_fail: taper -> magnitude-only, direction does not affect hand-drawnness; stays on existing axis
registry_consequences.taper_magnitude_control_fail: taper -> discriminability not established, results from b3t1-b3t4 invalidated, re-queue taper magnitude work
